scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: The Warning Was Already Here
cards.instruction: Choose one early detail as the warning sign, then let every later development reveal a larger version of the same disaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said that tiny crack in the stage was a warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now the piano's leaning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The crack has learned to accompany music.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to stop the concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start by listening to the stage. It auditioned its objection this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That little crack beside the piano was the stage warning us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The piano's leaning. Help me move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The crack's opened a place for the whole piano. Keep your end away from it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The front row's tilting too. I'm clearing the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's reached the audience. That little crack is taking the whole concert downstairs. I'll get the balcony.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects the crack and A3 enlarges it through the piano, but A5 returns to the initial warning without a larger disaster.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's leaning piano; A5's instruction to listen barely engages B4's need to stop the concert.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants an urgent intervention, while A5 offers a retrospective rebuke rather than a developed response.

heightening.evidence: A5 revisits what happened 'this morning' instead of expanding the consequence established by B2.

specificity.evidence: A1's stage crack and B2's leaning piano establish a concrete concert problem.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's musical personification is apt, but A5's 'auditioned its objection' repeats ornament instead of developing the situation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 names the small crack as warning; A3 expands it to the piano; A5 treats the threatened audience and concert as its larger disaster.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's leaning piano informs A3's moving advice; B4's tilting front row and evacuation lead A5 to take responsibility for the balcony.

relationship.evidence: B2 recruits practical help and B4 initiates clearing the hall; A3 and A5 cooperate while interpreting the expanding warning.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the crack's consequence from an instrument to the whole concert and adds an evacuation task prompted by B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 locates the crack beside the piano; B2 and B4 establish concrete physical deterioration and playable urgent tasks.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's concert going 'downstairs' follows the structural threat and A1's personified warning, though the danger dominates the humor.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the leaning piano and requests moving help; A3 connects its movement to the crack and joins the task.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 expands the danger to seating and begins evacuation; A5 interprets the concert-wide disaster and takes the balcony.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A consistently reads growing structural failure as fulfillment of the same early warning.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 enlarges both the threatened area and A's practical commitment without introducing another disaster.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A reads each widening structural failure as a larger expression of the same early crack's warning.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Saying 'I told you so' vindicates an earlier opinion; this card repeatedly scales one early detail into the developing disaster.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 connects the crack to the piano, and A5 connects B4's tilting front row to the entire concert following it.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision retains the stage setting and introduces spreading damage plus shared evacuation work. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 5, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 95. B4's front-row movement causes A5 to enlarge the crack's reach to the audience and take responsibility for another area.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. Because the warning is physically accurate, actors have less interpretive eccentricity to play than in the wedding alternative.
records.writerReservation: The structural escalation is theatrical compression; the scene needs sincere urgency to avoid becoming a sequence of decorative disaster metaphors.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a pairs literal expanding danger with cooperative action; b maps escalating administrative errors onto a metaphorical spreading typo.

cards.title: The Warning Was Already Here
cards.instruction: Choose one early detail as the warning sign, then let every later development reveal a larger version of the same disaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The first wedding invitation came back misspelled. That was the warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now the cake names the wrong couple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same mistake, larger icing budget.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The venue has two weddings booked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is. The typo has acquired a building.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They misspelled our wedding invitation. That was the warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake names another couple. Help me scrape it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same mistake, larger icing budget. Pass me a knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They booked that couple into our reception room too. We've both paid; I'm offering half.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The typo's taking half our wedding. Before you offer them my chair, check which name's on it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 selects a misspelled invitation; A3 and A5 read cake and venue confusion as enlargements of that error.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's wrong names and A5 uses B4's double booking, although misspelling and duplicate booking differ literally.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 bring consequential wedding updates but establish little personal objective beyond reporting them.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the naming error from invitation to cake to an entire building after B4's double-booking news.

specificity.evidence: A1's invitation, B2's cake names and B4's venue booking create an immediately playable wedding crisis.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'larger icing budget' and A5's typo acquiring a building compress the same escalating interpretation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 names the invitation misspelling as a warning; A3 reads the cake error as the same mistake at greater expense; A5 sees the reception conflict as the typo taking half the wedding. The link is interpretive rather than literal.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks for help scraping names off the cake, and A3 requests a knife. B4 offers half the room to the other paying couple, and A5 explicitly reacts to losing half the wedding and worries about the chair next.

relationship.evidence: B2 pursues a practical cake repair, while B4 negotiates shared space because both couples paid. These solutions give A3 and A5 concrete developments to reinterpret without reducing B to agreement.

heightening.evidence: B4 escalates from removable icing to a competing claim on the paid reception room. A5 converts B's compromise into the warning's larger fulfillment, then anticipates losing A's own chair.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a wedding invitation error naturally. B2's cake inscription and B4's double-booked reception provide immediately playable objects, stakes and practical choices.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'larger icing budget' compresses the escalating-error logic. A5's chair warning follows B4's offer of half the room, though it is a smaller comic image than the reception loss.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 introduces another couple's names on the cake and requests scraping help. A3 calls it the larger version of the initial error and requests the tool needed for B's repair.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reveals a reception booking conflict and proposes giving up half. A5 adopts that exact fraction as evidence of the expanding disaster and challenges further concessions through the chair warning.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 selects an early warning, and A3 and A5 consistently interpret later problems as enlargements of that original naming mistake.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The perceived naming disaster grows from invitation to cake to possession of the reception space. A5 incorporates B4's attempted solution into the same interpretation rather than introducing another game.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A selects the invitation error as an early warning and reads the cake's wrong names and competing room entitlement as larger versions of that identity disaster.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Accumulating unrelated wedding mishaps supplies escalating inconvenience; this card makes A repeatedly interpret each development through the same original naming warning.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 calls B2's wrong cake names the same mistake; after B4 establishes the named couple's competing paid booking, A5 treats lost reception space and threatened personal placement as the typo expanding.

records.recommendedEdit: The rejected candidate did not explain why B offered half the room. B4 now establishes duplicate paid bookings, giving B a credible reason to share and connecting the cake's other couple to the spatial consequence. The wedding setting remains; the competing paid entitlement is a new illustrative circumstance. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A1's naming warning expands through A3's icing comparison and A5's loss of wedding space; logic 4, B2 directly supplies A3's repair and comparison, and B4's explicit half-room offer supplies A5's half-wedding interpretation, though the typo's causal responsibility remains A's inference; relationship 4, B2 recruits practical help and B4 proposes sharing between paying couples; heightening 4, A5 follows B4's actual concession by protecting A's own named place; specificity 5, A1 establishes their wedding and B4 explains competing room claims; brevity 4, A3's icing budget and A5's chair concern develop the naming problem economically. Total 88. Five spoken ABABA turns, fewer than 75 words, and all hard gates pass on internal reread. Original firstPass is preserved exactly; this is model review only.
records.remainingConcern: A misspelling, another couple's cake and a booking conflict are not literally one error; A's sincere interpretation supplies their unity. The final chair image adds specificity more than scale. These are minor reservations; no rewrite is needed.
records.writerReservation: Both couples having paid motivates accommodation without making half-room sharing inevitable. The invitation typo still does not establish the literal cause of the later booking error; A sincerely interprets these as one spreading disaster.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative follows physical structural failure and cooperative evacuation. This candidate follows mistaken wedding identity while B repairs and bargains; the helpful compromise itself becomes A's next evidence of disaster.
